title: SOC Analyst / CyberOps Associate | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: SOC Analyst / CyberOps Associate. Category: Networking. Duration: 6 months. Description: Learn how to monitor, detect and respond to cyber threats and prepare for the Cisco Certified CyberOps Associate certification. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
